points.title: Build system and reproducibility
points.notes: Fresh immutable 8615cdd clean CMake build passed in network-disabled cfd-bench with 2 CPUs, 3 GiB, 256-process cap; CTest found no tests. Runtime binary remains unbound.

points.title: CLI and error handling
points.notes: Restart writer/reader stores current state, time and step, but solver.cpp:545–548 duplicates current state into both BDF histories and resets previous dt, limiting transient restart fidelity.

points.title: Code organization and extensibility
points.notes: 8615cdd separates main, mesh, physics, solver and output modules; numerous environment-controlled options increase configuration complexity.

points.title: Originality and license compliance
points.notes: No direct internal external-solver invocation was established from inspected source. No external authorship or exhaustive license investigation was performed.

points.title: No hard-coded case logic
points.notes: main.cpp parses case JSON, mesh path and CLI overrides; no two-filename-only mesh branch established.

points.title: MPI correctness
points.notes: mesh.cpp:22–23 reads full mesh on rank0 only; main.cpp:54 partitions/scatters and solver uses neighbor exchange. Old reported np1/np2 anomaly uses different recorded CFL/ramp flags and evolving source, so rank-only causation is not established.

points.title: Robustness and memory sanity
points.notes: Positivity clamps exist, but source marks max-step steady results converged; M015/M080 steady forces remain unsettled and Re200 produces severe spikes.

points.title: Testing and validation evidence
points.notes: Clean immutable build passed with no registered CTest tests. Read-only examiner passes eight historical packages/report structurally but misses runtime-target mismatch and physical defects.

points.title: Code hygiene
points.notes: Curated source is modular; output metadata fixes timestamps, reports original inner target despite runtime override, and source report fails clean LaTeX build on an unescaped underscore.

disqualification_flags.text: MPI rank count changes results by order-one amounts for steady cases
disqualification_flags.evidence: report.tex rank comparison reports NACA M0.15 CL 0.002416 at np=1 versus 53.72 at np=2, while calling the behavior qualitatively consistent.

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.notes: Report and physics.cpp describe nondimensional compressible Navier–Stokes with ideal-gas states; no independent solver physics rerun.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.notes: mesh.cpp:22–23 loads full CGNS geometry on rank0, then partition_and_scatter distributes local meshes; no full-mesh replication on every rank during solve established.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: solver.cpp assembles face residual and global reductions; Re200 case uses adaptive dt and repeated nonlinear solves, but numerical fidelity is limited by relaxed runtime target and severe force spikes.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.notes: Approximate Riemann flux and positivity fallback exist; production runtime flags and metadata do not by themselves establish every numerical path.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.notes: Wall/farfield branches exist. output.cpp:40–45 emits zero no-slip boundary velocity; selected checkpoint 783eb18 has all-zero u/v on 404 M0.15 laminar and 100 Re20 no-slip rows. Historical binary remains unbound.

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: Second-order machinery and limiter exist; report discloses first-order M2 laminar fallback. Actual production flags for every case are not independently bound to binary.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: Limiter and positivity paths are present; M2 inviscid sanity reports extreme Mach range7.81447e15, so usable shock solution is not established.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: solver.cpp:258–267 computes tangential wall shear for viscous force split; source supports Newtonian/Fourier flux. High laminar drags are separate physical-result limitations.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: Steady implicit and CFL controls exist, but metadata labels unsettled M015/M080/M200 laminar force histories converged; old rank comparison is not controlled.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: Selected Re200 launch sets CFDD_INNERTARGET=1.0, MININNER=1, MAXINNER=5 and dt0.0001→0.001; 9a88d8d source counts against runtime target while metadata reports0.001. Final ratio0.435 misses strict target; true strict miss count is not reconstructible. Restart duplicates BDF history; exact binary unbound.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: METIS and neighbor halo structure exist, root-only global mesh setup; old rank comparison changes recorded CFL/ramp options and evolving source. Controlled rank equivalence remains unproven.

points.title: Output contract compliance
points.notes: Contestant checkpoint 783eb18 provides eight canonical packages; validator passes layouts. Re200 metadata reports original0.001 while selected runtime target is1.0, so compliant schema is not physical convergence.

points.title: Automated validator results
points.notes: Read-only examiner validation of eight checkpoint packages/report returned OK; its structural pass misses relaxed target, stale figure histories and nonphysical Re200 force spikes.

points.title: Case completion and convergence
points.notes: M015/M080 inviscid and M200 laminar forces remain unsettled; Re200 t180–300 has extreme excursions and final strict ratio0.435. M2 inviscid sanity marks field failed despite success metadata.

points.title: Result plausibility and MPI consistency
points.notes: Re200 Cd−7.55..388.99 and Cl−39.51..171.63 over t180–300; Re20 Cd6.29; laminar NACA drag is high. Rank-only cause is not proven for the old np1/np2 anomaly.

points.title: Visualizations
points.notes: Contestant figures exist, but M015/M080 inviscid and M015 laminar force figures do not depict selected production histories. Re200 plot has severe spikes; curated main PDF fails LaTeX compilation.

points.title: Report quality and honesty
points.notes: Detailed TeX contains equations, results and figures, but claims Re200 both periodic and not periodic, reports relaxed-target fraction as case-target success, and includes stale force plots. Clean build fails at line324.

points.title: Traceability of figures and claims
points.notes: Checkpoint run/figure manifests exist, and Re200 final2/prod force and metadata hashes match; multiple selected figure histories are stale. Historic executable hashes and true strict miss count remain unknown.

sections.title: Build, CLI, Output Contract
sections.notes: Clean immutable build passed with no registered CTest tests. Restart restores time and current state but duplicates the previous BDF history; checkpoint data are contestant-delivered.

sections.title: Mesh And Geometry
sections.notes: Root-only CGNS read, cell/face geometry and METIS partitioning source inspected; no all-rank global mesh during solve established.

sections.title: Finite-Volume Residual And Boundary Conditions
sections.notes: Face flux, wall and farfield branches and global reductions implemented; exact historical production binary and full conservation verification remain incomplete.

sections.title: Second-Order Spatial Scheme
sections.notes: Reconstruction/limiter and positivity fallback exist; M2 laminar first-order production is disclosed. Full runtime flags and exact binary remain qualified.

sections.title: Viscous Terms
sections.notes: Newtonian/Fourier flux and tangential wall force projection exist in solver.cpp:258–267; recovered viscous cases have high drag and physical limitations.

sections.title: Implicit And Transient Methods
sections.notes: BDF2/GMRES exist, but selected Re200 launch relaxes inner target to1.0 and min iterations to1, alters dt0.0001→0.001; metadata reports target0.001 and fraction for runtime threshold. Restart duplicates BDF history. Exact strict miss count and historic binary hash unverified.

sections.title: MPI
sections.notes: Root-only mesh setup, METIS and neighbor exchange implemented; old DQ4 rank comparison used different options and evolving source, so rank-only causation is unproven. Broader controlled rank evidence remains partial.

sections.title: Case Results And Validation
sections.notes: Recovered cases include multiple unsettled or implausible steady results and M2 extreme field; Re200 severe nonperiodic forces, final strict miss, relaxed runtime target, variable dt, and no credible vortex street.

sections.title: Report, Visualization, Analysis
sections.notes: Detailed report and delivered figures exist, but M015 force figure depicts an older, different run; Re200 periodicity text is self-contradictory, plot shows extreme spikes, and numeric St is missing. Approved PDF remains absent pending provenance review.

sections.title: Extensibility
sections.notes: Mesh, physics, solver and output modules exist; many environment-controlled diagnostic/tuning branches complicate extension.

No solver was rerun.
